tours.title: Royal Rajasthan Heritage Tour
tours.description: Experience the grandeur of Hawa Mahal and City Palace in the Pink City. This comprehensive tour takes you through the heart of Rajasthan's capital, where every corner tells a story of royal heritage and cultural richness.
highlights: Traditional Rajasthani dinner with folk dance

itinerary.title: Arrival & City Palace
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaipur, check-in to hotel. Afternoon visit to City Palace complex with guided tour of royal apartments.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort Experience
itinerary.description: Morning elephant ride to Amber Fort, explore the magnificent architecture and enjoy panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Heritage & Culture
itinerary.description: Visit Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar observatory, and evening cultural program with dinner.

itinerary.title: Markets & Crafts
itinerary.description: Explore local markets, visit craft centers, and shopping at Johari Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Albert Hall Museum, afternoon departure.

tours.title: Desert Safari Adventure
tours.description: Explore the golden sands of Thar Desert with camel safari. Experience the magic of desert nights under starlit skies and the rich culture of desert villages.
highlights: Sunset camel ride in sand dunes

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaisalmer, visit the golden fort, explore ancient havelis.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Full day desert safari, sunset camel ride, overnight desert camping.

itinerary.title: Village Life
itinerary.description: Morning desert sunrise, visit local villages, departure.
